notes.title: FREE DEMO OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45269683/8a5136a85000d0e4241b4f2e63d1e219051bb951.png[/img]

Welcome to the Burnin' Rubber 6 - Pre-Alpha Demo!

This demo contains [b]4 Playable Tracks[/b] and [b]5 Playable Cars[/b] to try out. 
It also contains a Cup. Finish first at the end of 4 races to win it!
And of course don't forget to try out the new weapons!

Let us know what you think RIGHT HERE ON Steam of come to our Discord for more information on the game.

Like what you see; WISHLIST our game on Steam!

Thanks for trying out our game!

Team Xform
